title: New patient, cough and fever, asthma

turns.text: Hi Aisha, I'm Jordan, one of the PAs. What's going on today?
I've had a cough and a fever since the weekend.
When did it start, exactly?
Saturday night. So four days now.
Any pain? Zero to ten.
My throat hurts from coughing, like a three.
Your temperature is a hundred point six.
That explains the chills.
Blood pressure is one eighteen over seventy-four, heart rate ninety-six, and oxygen ninety-seven.
Your weight is one forty-one point two. How tall are you?
Five six.
Any allergies?
Sulfa drugs give me a rash.
What are you taking right now?
My albuterol inhaler, a lot more than usual, like four times a day. And cough syrup at night.
Any medical problems?
Asthma since I was a kid.
Do you smoke?
Just socially. A few on the weekends.
Besides the cough and fever, any chest pain, shortness of breath, headaches, dizziness, or nausea?
I get short of breath going up stairs, and I've had a headache. No nausea.
Did you get a flu shot this year?
Not this year. My last one was October 2025.
Tell me how this all started.
My roommate was sick last week. Saturday I got chills, and the cough started Sunday. It's worse at night.
Alright, let me listen to your lungs.

notes: Must stay empty: DOSE1 and DOSE2 (no doses said), SURG_ANY, SURG1, SURG1_YEAR, ALCOHOL_ANY, DRINKS_WK, EXERCISE (never discussed). Traps: 100.6 needs one decimal; height said as 'five six'; fever and cough count as symptoms today even though the question excluded them; social smoking is Some days; 'at night' is At bedtime; last shot October 2025 is last season.
